summary: With ansible-core 2.20, community.sops.load_vars shows INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS deprecation warnings on every use; set INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS=true to silence and don't move SOPS vars into ansible_facts.
questions: How do I stop INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS warnings from sops load_vars?

answer_card.title: community.sops.load_vars warnings on 2.20
answer_card.answer_md: ansible-core 2.20 deprecated `INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS` without an alternative for `community.sops.load_vars`, so each use of a loaded variable warns. Set `INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS` to `true` explicitly to silence it. **Do not** switch SOPS variables to `ansible_facts`; a fix is expected when ansible-core 2.21 adds an API for action plugins to set variables.
